name: FlyHouse
verdict: A private US private-aviation company founded by its chairman, Sanford Michelman. Nothing found.
note: Official Race Partner of the NorthStar SailGP Team since the 2025 Season; the partnership continues into the 2026 Season (SailGP press releases, 7 Mar 2025 and 14 Jan 2026). Rating note (2026-10-03): FlyHouse's founder and chairman is Sanford Michelman (Business Jet Traveler, 6 Jan 2026); his own law-firm bio says he 'founded and is Chairman of FlyHouse'. Its share register isn't public; no source names a state or state-fund shareholder, and no human-rights finding against the company was found.
